requirement: Global navigation breadcrumbs and footer follow the approved hierarchy
page_module_cta: PRIMARY NAV (7 items); all 15 PAGE ids
evidence: 43/43 tests pass; all 15 routes return 200 in dev. Footer link groups are seeded placeholders pending the Content Blueprint.

requirement: Editors manage assigned modular content without changing global tokens or publishing blocked evidence
evidence: Editor cannot change navigation, grant roles, or approve evidence. Design tokens live in CSS, not the CMS.

requirement: Every page/module stores stable Page ID and Module ID
evidence: pageId is a constrained select over the 15 approved IDs and is administrator-only. Every block carries a MOD ID; rendered modules emit data-module-id.

requirement: Seven qualified inquiry routes validate submit acknowledge and deliver to owners
evidence: All 7 routes submitted and delivered end to end via scripts/smoke-inquiry.ts; 21 messages captured in .mail/. Real owner mailboxes not configured.

requirement: Routing supports primary backup SLA and controlled escalation
evidence: Primary+backup+sender-ack rows created per lead. General never escalates to Tel. SLA breach reminds owners only; escalation stays a human decision.

requirement: Search returns current indexable content and excludes private/draft records
evidence: Published-only across 5 public collections; empty state handled; page is unconditionally noindex. Uses SQL LIKE, not a ranked index.

requirement: Video/audio uses approved sources captions/transcripts and responsive controls
evidence: The gate blocks publishing time-based media without captions/transcript. Player components are Phase 1/2.

requirement: Bios and press kits are versioned accessible and trackable
evidence: Versioned, gated, accessible-summary-required collection exists. Download UI and event wiring are Phase 2.

requirement: Consent-aware analytics records page CTA form start submit error and download events
evidence: All 8 baseline event names defined with minimum parameters. Nothing is sent without consent AND a measurement ID. No GA4 property configured, so no live event evidence exists yet.

requirement: UTM/source context persists through navigation and submission
evidence: Attribution reaches the lead record; query strings are stripped from paths; consent denial records consent-denied rather than an invented source.

requirement: Indexable pages have unique title description H1 canonical OG and schema
evidence: Title/description/robots/OG implemented and verified in dev. Canonical and sitemap are deliberately suppressed until productionOrigin is set. Person/Organization schema is Phase 2.

requirement: Core journeys support keyboard focus labels contrast zoom and screen-reader use
evidence: Skip link, focus-visible never removed, reduced-motion, labelled fields with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, aria-live results, semantic landmarks. Contrast COMPUTED and passing. NO automated scan and NO manual screen-reader test has been run.

requirement: Data collection consent retention and contact practices follow approved policy
evidence: Consent is required before submission and stamped with a policy version. That version is literally 'draft-unapproved'. Retention periods are not implemented — they require reviewer decisions.

requirement: TLS secure headers least privilege validation rate limiting and patching are active
evidence: Least privilege, server-side validation, URL-protocol blocking, DB-backed rate limiting and CSRF/CORS confined to the configured origin, all verified. Security headers and TLS are deployment concerns and are NOT yet configured. No dependency audit run.

requirement: Priority templates meet agreed Core Web Vitals/performance budgets
evidence: Budgets are undefined — the baseline supplies no numeric thresholds. Proposing and agreeing them is a Phase 3 task. No measurement has been taken.

requirement: Monitoring backups release versioning and tested rollback are available
evidence: Committed migrations, durable outbox with bounded retries and dead-lettering, append-only audit trail. Monitoring, backups, restore drill and rollback rehearsal are NOT done.
